maya: quick heads-up 3 i'm opening a PR to tidy the Optimize toolkit docs: tighten batching examples, add a short prefix-cache note, and clarify quant profile migration steps. PR soon.

maya: draft will include a compact batch snippet for python/js and a tiny eval script.

tony: prefer minimal examples only in quickstart and link to the full checklist in tuning page. avoids duplication.

liam: +1 on a minimal batched call example. support gets a lot of customers sending sequential single requests. small fix: show batch_size param.

maya: added python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model='rw1-quant-v2', prompts=['A','B'], batch_size=2)
print(resp.texts)
```

maya: and JS:
```js
const client = new Redwood()
await client.generate({model:'rw1-quant-v2',prompts:['A','B'],batch_size:2})
```

tony: add one sentence comparing batching vs streaming (throughput vs single-request latency). also a rule: batch_size = min(8, concurrency).

maya: will add that and a short note about Dedicated GPU memory tradeoffs.

liam: include a tiny eval loop that reports avg latency so customers can validate quant changes quickly.

maya: adding basic eval snippet and a rollback threshold note: "if quality drops >3% on your metric, try fp16 fallback."

docs-bot: [link-check] flagged moved anchor for quant profiles -> suggest /optimize/quantization#profile-compatibility.

maya: fixed anchor and will run local link-check then push PR.

tony: i'll review once PR is open.
